title_en: Fall 2026 Graduate Research Ethics Online Training: Period Extended to October 31
summary: Fall 2026 new graduate students, and current graduate students who have not completed the research ethics course and online training, are asked to complete the research ethics online training. The course period has been extended to Saturday, October 31, 2026; BK21 participating graduate students may take it until December 2026. The course is taken online through eTL (https://etl.snu.ac.kr) under 'SNUON-강좌목록'.
applies_to: Graduate students who have not yet completed the training, specifically: (1) new graduate students admitted in Fall 2026 (2026학년도 2학기); and (2) current graduate students who have not completed the research ethics course (교과목) and online training. The notice asks these students to take the course within the period; it does not use the word 'mandatory' and states no penalty. BK21 participating graduate students have a later deadline.

dates.what: Course period for the research ethics online training (all eligible students)
Extended deadline to complete the training (all eligible students except BK21 participants)
Deadline for BK21 participating graduate students only

conditions: Completion is recognised only when you watch 100% of all videos and download and view the learning materials (PDF).
BK21 participating graduate students may take the course until December 2026; all other students must finish by October 31, 2026.
You must register for the course that matches your field (Humanities and Social Sciences, or Science and Engineering).
Students who have already completed the research ethics course and online training are not included in the target group.
steps: Read the attached course guide (Korean and English versions); its contents were not read for this translation.
Log in to eTL at https://etl.snu.ac.kr.
Click 'SNUON-강좌목록' (SNUON course list) on the left side of the page.
Register for the course matching your field: '2026-2) 대학원생을 위한 연구윤리(인문사회계 / 이공계)' or '2026-2) Research ethics for graduate students (Humanities and Social Sciences / Science and Engineering)'.
Watch 100% of all videos and download and view the learning materials (PDF) by October 31, 2026 (BK21 participants: by December 2026).
After completing the course, print your certificate of completion (이수증) yourself if needed.
translation:
Fall 2026 Graduate Student Research Ethics Training: Extension of Period (until October 31)

The course period for the Fall 2026 graduate student research ethics online training has been extended to Saturday, October 31, 2026. Graduate students who have not yet completed it are asked to take the course within the period.

A. Course title
- 2026-2) 대학원생을 위한 연구윤리(인문사회계 / 이공계)
- 2026-2) Research ethics for graduate students (Humanities and Social Sciences / Science and Engineering)

B. Who should take the course
- New graduate students in Fall 2026 (2026학년도 2학기)
- Current students who have not completed the research ethics course (교과목) and online training

C. Course period: Tuesday, September 1, 2026 to Saturday, October 31, 2026
※ BK21 participating graduate students may take the course until December 2026.

D. How to take the course
- Access eTL (https://etl.snu.ac.kr) → click 'SNUON-강좌목록' (SNUON course list) on the left → search for '연구윤리 / Ethics' → register (수강신청) for the course matching your field → take the course
※ Completion is recognised when you watch 100% of all videos and download and view the learning materials (PDF). After completing the course, you can print your certificate of completion (이수증) yourself.

Attachment: Fall 2026 Graduate Student Research Ethics Training Course Guide (Korean/English), one copy each.
Attached files (2):
- 2026 2nd-Semester Research Ethics course sign-up Guide for Graduate Students.pdf (73 KB)
- 2026학년도 2학기 대학원생 연구윤리 교육 수강 안내.pdf (87 KB)

[Note: The contents of the attached files were not read for this translation.]
